notes: No new users/channels needed; all roles map to existing seed rows already members of C_MODEL and T01WORKSPACE. Only the four message_reactions rows required by the design were missing from the base seed and were inserted (Priya's absence of any reaction on the target message was already true, so no edit was needed for that negative). The actor (U01AGENBOT9) already has channel_members access to C_MODEL and user_teams membership in T01WORKSPACE, so no membership edits were required for solver discovery via conversations.history/reactions.get. Because message_reactions' only valid adjacency to 'messages' is via message_id (not user_id), the focal query follows the assigned route order literally (users -> user_teams -> teams -> channels -> messages -> message_reactions) to establish workspace/channel/message context, and a genuinely independent auxiliary query (users -> message_reactions, joined validly via message_reactions.user_id, which does connect those two adjacent tables) ties the specific tada reaction on the announcement message back to the root user, closing the identity loop that the route's terminal REACTION->participant hop requires.
